firm_data.firm_description: Davis+Gilbert's proactive, business-oriented approach stems from our long history of working with key industries not just as advocates but also as counselors. From our base in New York, we represent a diverse range of clients across the country and around the world.
notable_facts: The firm guided the marketing communications ecosystem as it evolved from the early 20th century to today’s world of data, digital and social media.
The firm focuses on real estate, financial services, hospitality, technology and other service sector industries.
